WELCOME TO
The Carriages Boutique Hotel And Vineyard
The Carriages is a charming family-owned boutique hotel located in central Pokolbin near to the main amenities, but tucked away in a quiet vineyard setting.
The accommodation comprises a country-style 8 room Guesthouse, each with ensuite, and a quaint Cottage with 2 ensuite bedrooms and large living room with kitchen, dining and open fireplace.
Entering the 36 acre estate you will drive slowly through the vineyard, not to disturb the kangaroos and wallabies, and arrive at the picturesque accommodation ready to unwind and commence your experience of country style luxury, perhaps with a swim or tennis, or simply relaxing on the sweeping verandah enjoying the tranquil setting and bird songs.
In the afternoon after exploring the sights of Pokolbin relax with cheese and wine, make new friends with your neighbours, and in the evening
f rom May to September snuggle in front of the open fire (most rooms).
In the morning wake up to the birds singing and a breakfast hamper provided just outside your door.
Take the opportunity to leave the car behind and walk to nearby Cellar Doors, Restaurants, Cafes, weekend markets, and gin or whiskey tastings.
If you prefer to explore the area with us then call and book our own personalised Carriages wine and food tour.
Accommodation
Just 10 beautifully appointed
en-suite rooms with vintage charm, set in a picturesque vineyard estate with pool and tennis court. Enjoy a continental breakfast on the sprawling verandah or winter fire with a bottle of Carriages award-winning wine, a game of tennis or a swim.
Enjoy a stroll to several top restaurants, chocolate shop, cafe, wineries, markets and wedding venues.
Wines
The Carriages produces a small volume of premium
quality
hand-picked wines , including Chardonnay and Shiraz grown on the estate, and occasional Provence-style Ros . The wines are expertly crafted by one of the Hunter Valley's best winemakers to produce award-winning vintages. The wines are available in-room, at the cellar door or ordered online.
Testimonials
Brilliant Relaxing Boutique Hotel
Enjoyed a lovely 2 night stay here recently for a wedding nearby. Perfect central location, very comfortable and cozy room with a fantastic bedding package. Morning breakfast basket was enjoyed on the sun filled deck looking of the manicured lawns, very tranquil and relaxing environment. The owners so hospitable and attentive to all needs. five star service will definitely be back with friends.
Button
Romantic relaxing and cosy
Loved our stay at Carriages. The room was so lovely with the wood fire and scenic back drop we didn't see another soul our whole stay. Instead of going for an expensive dinner we splurged at the cheese shop and stayed in with some wine and a movie. Lots of space and wonderful little touches have recommended to all our friends heading to the valley.
Button
Romantic, quiet - perfect Hunter Valley.
We were married at Circa 1876 on the weekend and hired this venue for accommodation for bridal party and some guests - it was absolutely perfect! The owner greeted us on arrival and personally delivered a breakfast basket to our rooms daily. It is quiet - only noise you will hear is the chirping of birds and other nature. We even went back here for photos during ceremony and reception as it is so picturesque. The wine is great too - would absolutely recommend to anyone with a group or looking for a romantic weekend away in the Hunter Valley.
Button
Our top 5 activities to enjoy in the Hunter Valley:
Go Ballooning
Drift over the Vineyards at sunrise on a magical Hot Air Balloon Ride.
Enjoy The Carriages
Simply relax, enjoy a Sumptuous Platter by the Pool or overlooking the Dam and Vineyard. Sit by the Fire with a Glass of Wine. Talk a stroll next door for a wine-tasting, lunch or dinner.
Take a Vineyard Tour
Discover the Hunters iconic & boutique wineries, cheese & chocolate shops, craft beers and spirits, gardens and beautiful countryside starting with a pick-up from our reception door, or ask about our walking wine tour.
Experience Amazing Food
The Hunter Valley is renowned for it's wonderful dining experiences. Choose from some of Australia's top restaurants showcasing local produce including award-winning wines.
Play a round of Golf
We are conveniently located just minutes from The Vintage and Cypress Lakes Championship Golf Courses.

Stay
Escape to the Country
The Carriages accommodation includes a country style Guesthouse and Cottage, swimming pool and tennis court. Our landscaped setting offers a peaceful and relaxing stay, with a chance to enjoy the complimentary breakfast on the verandah or balconies listening to the birds and spotting kangaroos and wallabies.
The Guesthouse is a large, twin-gabled country house, featuring 6 ensuite rooms set along a large sunny verandah, and above are 2 grand gable suites.
The 6 verandah rooms are accessed through French doors, and include their own ensuite, buffet and mini bar. There are 4 larger Suites with fireplaces, and 2 smaller Rooms at each end with lovely corner setting.
Upstairs in the gables there are 2 very large rooms provining a king double plus single bed, cathedral ceilings, leadlight windows, a stunning open fireplace, and a private balcony. In winter firewood may be purchased for a special experience.
Please note: Bookings are available for adults and children 10 and over only. No toddlers, infants or pets.
Rosebank Cottage
is nestled in its own garden. It's a short walk through the whispering She-oak trees from The Guesthouse and swimming pool. It features 2 suites with their own ensuites, and a large sitting room with open log fire and full kitchen.
Book the 'Cottage' for your private getaway and enjoy relaxing on the verandah in the morning sun listening to kookaburra's and spotting our local wallabies. Children and infants welcome.
